pages.text: A motor and a rotor under a big horn that **turns round** as it sounds: its wail swells each time the horn sweeps past you. Heard 160 blocks off. Two signals, as the Cold War's: **Attack** (a wail rising and falling) and **Alert** (steady). When an attack ends it sounds the **All Clear**, steady, for fifteen seconds. It winds up as it starts and coasts down as it stops. Stand it on top of a post.

A horn for the wall, heard 64 blocks off, with five tones: the **klaxon** (a-oo-ga); the **slow whoop**; **evacuate** (three blasts and a pause, the evacuation signal of fire alarms); **hi-lo** (two tones); the **general alarm** (seven short blasts and a long one, a ship's call to stations).
An electric bell for the wall, heard 48 blocks off.
